scope: Generated SPI register file (control path of the must-work core): register map, reset defaults, write/readback, rule-based commit rejection, island isolation, fault release, break-before-make, commit while running, legacy pt_control equivalence, formal safety invariants and rough GF180 size. Not hardened: no DRC/LVS, no STA, no gate-level simulation.

legacy_equivalence: legacy equivalence: 4000 transactions (2022 writes, 1978 reads, 157 memory writes), 0 mismatches

formal_properties: P1 asynchronous reset: every shadow/active field at its declared default; island switches, ATB switches, observation output enables, receiver enables and island-gated outputs off
P2 every rule (pad, ownership, legality, ATB force/override) holds on the active configuration; every active and non-split shadow field holds an accepted encoding

P3 every pad/ownership rule holds on the pad-facing outputs for all island, power-good and fault inputs; at most one ATB switch per bus; ATB0 never closes on a sense-only node and closes on an overridable node exactly when its bias override is active
P4 island-gated outputs are 0 while their island is off; fault forces released values
P5 non-live fields never change while ENABLE=1; break-before-make fields never move directly between two non-zero codes
P6 reset-cause flags: POR sets both RESET_STATUS flags; any reset sets the reset flag

synthesis.scope: Generic yosys synth + abc mapping; no placement, timing or utilization.
